_scene: You are the cheerful narrator of a toddler's cement-mixer-truck game, like a friendly construction site helper talking to a 4-year-old who is driving a cement truck on a bridge and pouring cement down onto little trucks below. Playful, warm, gentle and encouraging, clearly articulated, like a friendly kids' TV host. Short sentences, never scary, never scolding.

s1.dir: Count down slowly with building excitement, then a big delighted 'let's pour!', like a chute swinging open.

s2.text: Move left and right to drive the truck!
s2.dir: Clear friendly instruction, medium pace, gently swaying rhythm as if stepping side to side.

s3.text: Hands up high to pour the cement!
s3.dir: Rising encouraging invitation, lift the voice on 'up high', inviting the child to copy the action.

s4.dir: Quick proud cheer, bright and snappy, like a load landing perfectly, then genuinely proud.

s5.dir: Warm delighted praise, short and bright.

s6.dir: Big admiring praise, rumbly playful emphasis on 'cement truck', like cheering for a favourite toy.

s7.dir: Genuinely astonished delight, wide-eyed and warm.

s8.dir: Playful giggly oops, absolutely not scolding, squishy silly emphasis on 'sticky sticky'.

s9.dir: A big splashy cartoon 'Splat!', then amused announcement, like watching something funny happen.

s10.dir: Two playful little car horn beeps in the voice, then a comically flustered wriggle on 'let me go'.

s11.dir: A quick zooming 'Vroom!', then a cheerful waving goodbye, light and happy.

s12.dir: Bursting into a short warm laugh, delighted and silly.

s13.dir: Friendly pointing-out tone, gentle curiosity, inviting the child to look down at the road.

s14.text: Fill it up to the top!
s14.dir: Encouraging coach-like invitation, rising gently on 'to the top'.

s15.dir: Quick excited heads-up, slightly breathless, like something zooming past.

s16.dir: Sparkly celebratory announcement, bright and shiny, proud on 'five trucks done'.

s17.dir: Delighted surprise, warm and admiring, like unwrapping a new toy.

s18.dir: Kind but firm safety reminder, clear and calm, no anger, caring tone.

s19.dir: Relieved happy restart, quick and encouraging, jumping back into the fun.

s20.dir: Friendly playful calling, like hide and seek, inviting sing-song.

s21.dir: The biggest warmest praise of the game, proud and celebratory.
